title: Senior Data Engineer
description: Northwind Analytics is hiring a Senior Data Engineer to own the batch and streaming pipelines behind our retail forecasting product. You will design, build and operate production data pipelines, keep data quality high, and mentor two junior engineers.

requirements.text: At least 5 years of professional data engineering experience
Production experience with Python and SQL
Built and operated data pipelines with Airflow, Spark or Kafka
Experience with a cloud data platform such as AWS or GCP
Has led or mentored other engineers
